The item wears out 4 times faster.
enchantment.enchantsplus.breeze_burst.de: Arrows spawn a wind charge when they hit a block. A renewable alternative to wind charges.
enchantment.enchantsplus.clumsiness_curs: When attacking or mining, the item may drop on the ground.
enchantment.enchantsplus.crabs_touch.des: Increases block interaction reach (up to 7.5 blocks at level 3). Held in the offhand, it also lets you place blocks from far away.
enchantment.enchantsplus.displacement_cu: Sometimes teleports enemies away, trying to put them behind you.
enchantment.enchantsplus.double_edge_cur: 40% chance for the weapon to hurt you when used.
enchantment.enchantsplus.gluttony.desc: Mined blocks go straight into your inventory. Level 2 works with Crab's Touch reach, level 3 also collects XP.
enchantment.enchantsplus.graviole.desc: Your elytra resists gravity: longer flights, but you can't dive to gain speed, so flight is slower.
enchantment.enchantsplus.ice_aspect.desc: 10% (level 1) or 20% (level 2) chance to freeze enemies for 3 seconds. Frozen players can still turn and fight back. Incompatible with Fire Aspect and Websnare.
enchantment.enchantsplus.kinetic_protect: Protects you from elytra kinetic damage.
enchantment.enchantsplus.luminosity.desc: You emit light: level 5, 10 or 15 depending on the enchantment level.
enchantment.enchantsplus.outreach.desc: Increases attack reach (4 blocks at level 2). Incompatible with Swift Strike.
enchantment.enchantsplus.precision.desc: Reduces projectile curve for better accuracy. Higher levels increase the effective range.
enchantment.enchantsplus.pyrolysis.desc: Auto-smelts mined blocks. Incompatible with Fortune and Silk Touch.
enchantment.enchantsplus.retrieval.desc: Arrows shot at you may go into your inventory (80% chance at level 4). Tipped arrow effects are lost.
enchantment.enchantsplus.scorch_walker.d: Lava version of Frost Walker: creates magma blocks to walk on lava. Also protects from magma and powder snow damage.
enchantment.enchantsplus.stride.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping, as if they were stairs.
enchantment.enchantsplus.toxic.desc: Arrows poison the target for 11 seconds. Undead mobs are immune.
enchantment.enchantsplus.vitality.desc: Increases max health (13 hearts at level 3).
enchantment.enchantsplus.websnare.desc: Chance to spawn a cobweb under the target, trapping it. Incompatible with Fire Aspect and Ice Aspect.
